test_gym_wrapper_continuous: test the Habitat Gym wrapper contract for continuous action spaces like reach_state and pick tasks
test_gym_wrapper_discrete: test the Habitat Gym wrapper contract for discrete action spaces like imagenav and pointnav tasks
test_full_gym_wrapper: test the Habitat-v0 and HabitatRender-v0 Gym wrappers with configurable override options and render modes
test_auto_gym_wrapper: test all auto-registered Habitat Gym wrappers from benchmark YAML config files with human rendering
